Review.ItemLabel: Create organization refreshes grid in-circuit without browser reload

Steps.Action: Sign in as admin@acmecoffee.com with role SystemAdmin
Navigate via the Admin drawer group to Security Dashboard (URL ends at /admin/security).
Click the Organization Master Details tab

Verifications.Text: Organization master grid is visible

Steps.Action: Generate a fresh 8-character hex marker you will reuse in steps 6, 7, and the verifications at step 9. Any 8-hex string works; this checklist uses `a1b2c3d4` as the example. The Playwright test computes its marker via `Guid.NewGuid().ToString("N").Substring(0, 8)`.
Click the organization-grid-add-button button
Fill the Key field with `customer-uat-a1b2c3d4` (substitute the 8-hex marker you chose in step 4).
Fill the Name field with `UAT New a1b2c3d4` (substitute the same 8-hex marker you chose in step 4).
Click the organization-save-button button
Click the organization-master-details-shell-header to re-expand the results grid

Verifications.Text: The row with key `customer-uat-a1b2c3d4` is visible in the grid without any browser refresh (using the marker you chose in step 4).
The row with name `UAT New a1b2c3d4` is visible in the grid (using the marker you chose in step 4).

Review.Feedback: The new organization is not visible in the grid.
